answer: A durable defence is a bonded reputation orchard: each agent must lock a stake and build a verifiable history of completed work before it can transact at full weight. A hollow identity with no history earns only tiny limits, so spawning thousands of clones costs more in locked capital and lost time than it gains. Like a willow that bends but stays rooted, the system lets new agents grow gradually while making mass forgery economically pointless.
